notes.selection: nearest_component: group the features carrying the road's tigerNames into components by shared vertices, take the one nearest the origin, and fail unless it is under maxDistanceM away and contains every name in tigerNames.
notes.clip: Bounds are true metres, before any compression. Keep the whole TIGER vertices with xMinM <= x <= xMaxM. Never interpolate an end vertex, so every vertex keeps its TIGER lon/lat.
notes.mtfcc: width is paved width in metres. Widths and surfaces are assumed defaults by road class, not surveyed: TIGER records neither.
notes.overrides: Road id to {width, surface, reason}. Empty because there is no evidence for any override yet.
notes.compressionBands: One global remap of x, f: the identity on the stretch holding town center, scaled by factor inside a band, a constant shift past it towards town. trueFrom and trueTo are true metres, west to east, with no overlap. z and lon/lat never change. The build fails if a graph node or trestle is inside a band or a band edge is within 1 mm of a kept TIGER vertex, and adds a vertex wherever a kept segment crosses a band edge.

clip.basis: 500 m past the west trestle (x -4160.2) and the Meehan Savoy Rd junction (x 5807.8), rounded out to 10 m. US 80 crosses each bound once. It ends at TIGER vertices x -4663, z 183 and x 6258, z -574.

continuation.basis: TIGER's Adams St ends 870 m from US 80, short of I-20. All three names carry the same geometry from its north end to clipAt, so take that geometry once. clipAt is the road's first contact with an S1630 ramp of the I-20 interchange, 774.0 m on, and TIGER leaves no gap. The road's first shared vertex with I-20 itself is 144.4 m further north.

S1400.label: Local neighborhood road, rural road or city street

compressionBands.reason: US 80 from just past Stuckey's Bridge to the west trestle: 260 m with no junction, on the run the game opens with.
compressionBands.basis: The game's bridge is US 80's crossing of the river at true x -4505.3, and the player runs east from it into town, 4.2 km at 4.4 m/s or 16 minutes. These first three bands bring the edge of town to about a minute. x -4440 leaves the 65 m past the crossing true, for the bridge's ground. x -4180 stops 20 m short of the west trestle (x -4160.2), which a band can't hold.

compressionBands.reason: US 80 from the west trestle towards town: 3.03 km with no junction, the longest empty stretch on the map, and the railroad and river run beside it.
compressionBands.basis: 20 m east of the west trestle to 15 m west of Church St's end (x -1097.1), which a band can't hold either. It becomes 61 m long. A factor this small turns every gentle line in it nearly north-south. The game lays US 80 straight here, so the road doesn't show it.

compressionBands.reason: US 80 coming into town, and the far end of Church St: 432 m with no junction.
compressionBands.basis: 15 m east of Church St's end to 367 m west of Adams Street. x -650 leaves Church St's first 370 m true, and it's the west edge of the stretch the town is built on. Church St's last 432 m become 43 m, so that end runs well north of its true bearing.

compressionBands.reason: US 80 between the far east trestle and Meehan-Savoy Rd: 3.84 km with no junction or trestle, over four times the camera's 900 m far plane. It still holds one river crossing, and the railroad and river run through it. Their order is kept, but bearings inside the band change.
compressionBands.basis: 150 m east of trestle-east-far (x 1072.95) and 150 m west of Meehan-Savoy Rd's minimum x (x 5213.20), to the nearest metre. The band becomes 960 m long, about one far plane. x 1220 was rejected because it's 3 mm from a river vertex: the nearest kept vertices to these edges are 0.855 m and 1.647 m away.
